beta.atm_vol_30d_method: near / next ATM mid IVs of the replicated VIX's own terms, combined with the VIX constant-maturity weights

deviations: R is the ^IRX bill rate (cc), not Cboe's CMT spline; dVIX/dR ~ VIX T / 2.
Calculation time is the chain's T origin; Yahoo snapshots carry no quote time.
parity_forward replaces the single-strike forward with the cleaned chain's parity-regression F and D (robust to one stale strike).
K0 falls back to the nearest lower strike with both sides quoted when the listed K0 lacks one (two-sided-only storage); flagged per term.
VIX9D/VIX3M/VIX6M use the VIX candidate set and bracket rule at 9/93/184 days (analogues, not Cboe's index-specific series sets).
Root-less (pre-C22) chains are treated as PM-settled.
gap_notes: The stored chain keeps 384 zero-bid lines; the zero-bid stop rule is applied as published.

No quote time is stored for this snapshot (Yahoo); the calculation uses 16:00 ET on the session and the official close is the 16:15 ET print (the official index traded 15.22-15.88 that session). Any intraday drift between the snapshot and 16:15 is unmeasured.
Model variance swaps at 30 days (k in [-3, 2], wings beyond the fitted K/F 0.70-1.30 extrapolated, so each inherits its model's wing bias): SVI-cal 14.92, SVI 14.99, eSSVI 14.52.

Gap attribution (VIX, SVI-cal surface): replicated - official = -0.30. Strikes beyond the stored strip would add +0.24 under the surface's wing; the stored quotes beyond the fitted K/F 0.70-1.30 are about as rich as that wing. Inside the fitted range market and surface differ by +0.01. Left unexplained by the chain: +0.05 (official - replicated - truncation): snapshot timing vs the 16:15 ET print, stale quotes, rate.
